svg.title: TaskFlow API — Sequence: CRUD flows (update, mark complete, add dummy)
svg.desc: Sequence diagram of the remaining CRUD flows. Update: the client PUTs a task body; a blank title fails @Valid with 400, otherwise the service looks the task up, throws TaskNotFoundException (404) if absent, else applies the new title and completed flag and saves it, returning 200. Mark complete: the same find-then-save shape, but the service only sets completed to true. Add dummy: the service inserts five predefined sample tasks in a loop and the controller returns 201 with an empty body.
svg.text: TaskFlow API — Sequence: CRUD Flows (2 of 2)
Update · mark as complete · add dummy data
HTTP client → TaskController → TaskService → TaskRepository → Task model
